opening.argument: The presentation does more than discuss cryptocurrency as a developing technology: it promotes OneCoin as an exceptional market opportunity by framing it as “The next Bitcoin is hear called Onecoin” and claiming that a new coin “will become one of the most successful currencies on the crypto market.” It reinforces that future-success message by saying, “Bitcoin shows us the way, but the best is still to come,” directing viewers toward an anticipated appreciation opportunity. The description also provides a direct signup pathway, “www.onecoin.eu/signup/onedreamteamco,” showing that the message invites participation rather than offering neutral commentary. Taken together, the comparison to Bitcoin, the prediction of major market success, and the supplied registration link establish promotional solicitation for purchasing the token.

citations.quote: The next Bitcoin is hear called Onecoin
A new, innovative crypto coin is aiming for the sky and will become one of the most successful currencies on the crypto market.
Bitcoin shows us the way, but the best is still to come.
